description: A kind of build piece (design doc §8.3, §6.3; M3 spec claim 1). occupies: a whole build cell or one cell face. orientation restricts face pieces to vertical (walls, doors, windows) or horizontal (floors, hatches) faces. passable pieces are openings: cheap portal edges. target pieces are what raids path to. climb_ticks > 0 makes a stair (a cell piece with orientation facing: placed with the facing of its foot) or a ladder (a horizontal passable face) climbable between storey n and n+1; mantle lets an actor pull up onto a cell piece's top (M6 claim 2). A transparent opening passes sight even closed (a window); a closed opaque one blocks it (M6 claim 3).
